name: BSP_LoadingScreen_AdvanceHint

name: BSP_LoadingScreen_TickHint
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet loading_screen_elements, read-only analysis. __fastcall(this), RET 0. Called by 0057C990 and by the 25 Hz worker callback 0057CA00. Two strict gates: 0057C4D5 requires +30h - +50h > +4Ch (the difference is formed in x87 extended precision and compared without narrowing), and 0057C50F requires the age of the timestamp at +38h, taken through clock 01090AB0 vtable +20h and BSP_Timestamp_Subtract, to exceed +48h. Then 0057C360 and +50h = +30h. The three pushes at 0057C4E0..0057C4EF serve two callees: the clock method takes only the destination (RET 4, EAX = destination) and the other two are 00530890's stack arguments (RET 8); 0057C360's one-push call of the same slot fixes the split. This is NOT the vtable +10h initialiser that docs/GAME_FRONTEND_ENTRY.md guessed; that is 0057C560. docs/LOADING_SCREEN_ELEMENTS.md
